# Omaha Water Heater Pros

> Omaha Water Heater Pros provides water heater repair, installation, replacement and maintenance in Omaha, Nebraska. Operating since 2013. Licensed and insured, same-day service available, upfront honest pricing, satisfaction guaranteed. Call-focused service: see the contact page to reach the team.

## Services

- [Water Heater Repair](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/): Diagnosis and repair of tank and tankless water heaters in Omaha, including leaks, no hot water, noises and rusty water.
- [Tankless Water Heater Repair](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/tankless-water-heater-repair/): Tankless repairs including descaling, ignition faults and heat exchanger problems.
- [Water Heater Installation](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/water-heater-installation/): New water heater installation sized and fitted for Omaha homes.
- [Water Heater Replacement](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/water-heater-replacement/): Replacement of old, leaking or inefficient water heaters, with repair-vs-replace guidance.
- [Tankless Water Heater Installation](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/tankless-water-heater-installation/): Tankless water heater installation and conversion.
- [Emergency Water Heater Repair](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/emergency-water-heater-repair/): Urgent water heater repairs in Omaha for leaks and total hot water loss.
- [Water Heater Maintenance](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/water-heater-maintenance/): Flushing, anode rod checks and maintenance to protect tanks from Omaha hard water sediment.
- [Commercial Water Heater Repair](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/commercial-water-heater-repair/): Water heater service for Omaha businesses.
- [Gas Water Heater Repair](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/gas-water-heater-repair/): Gas water heater repairs covering pilot lights, thermocouples, gas valves and venting.
- [Electric Water Heater Repair](https://omahawaterheaterpros.com/electric-water-heater-repair/): Electric water heater repairs covering heating elements, thermostats and breakers.

## Notes

- Omaha water is hard (around 9-10 grains per gallon), which causes sediment buildup in tank water heaters; annual flushing is recommended.
- The business serves Omaha, NE only.
